chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The one who brings goods to the market is provided sustenance, and the hoarder is cursed.

key_terms.اَلْجَالِبُ: the one who brings goods or supplies to the market
key_terms.اَلْمُحْتَكِرُ: the one who hoards goods to manipulate supply or price
key_terms.مَرْزُوقٌ: granted sustenance and provision by Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about bringing goods to market and hoarding?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the one who supplies goods for people’s needs and warns against hoarding. It highlights the moral and social value of fair trade and condemns withholding commodities in ways that harm the community.
